title: Octagonal Well-and-Outlet Landing Platform
description: One original complete static spacebase landing-facility appearance, not an isolated landing leg or a rearrangement of existing platforms. One continuous grounded octagonal plinth has a broad upper landing field around a real square top well. The well opens into a wider low inner chamber that continues out through the front wall, with complete material floor, ceiling and side boundaries. A whole solid side approach reaches the landing field through a short level upper landing. The plinth is one connected closed shared-boundary mesh, with no buried closed primitive seams or internal construction-cell faces. Landing-field border markings are face material assignments rather than coplanar overlays. Two closed editable meshes and four opaque constant untextured PBR materials. Metres, native Z up, front -Y, actual ground bottom Z0 and complete horizontal envelope centred. No craft, old landing struts, copied sector-platform piers, solar arrays or reused railway ramp geometry. Static art only: not a working landing pad, launch system, exhaust duct, thermal protection system, gas-flow simulation, structural design, load rating, accessibility provision or safety instruction; no real vehicle fit, landing, operation or engineering performance claim.
